findings.summary: skills[].totalExperience has NO validation at all (entry check requires only 'id'). The field is a live input to getPrecursorFlatDamageBonus (floor(t/10), unbounded flat damage on tram/linh_bao/huy_quyen - linh_bao is the beta starter) and to getCastLeveledSkillLevel (>=10000 casts -> Lv3, feeding hidden-pathway offer gates). The writer increments totalExperience and writes player.skillCastCounts[id] in the SAME statement (SkillSystem ~L323+L336 -> castCountSink), so every honest save has skillCastCounts[id] === totalExperience whenever tExp > 0. Absent/divergent mirror = unproducible, and a non-numeric value = unproducible - none of these is checked, while the same one-writer coherence pattern IS enforced for skillInsight<=totalSkillInsightGained and node/purchase mirrors.
mint_paths: totalExperience=1000000 with no skillCastCounts mirror: validateGameSaveShape ok=true, restore lands it verbatim, getPrecursorFlatDamageBonus -> +100000 flat damage on the beta starter linh_bao
totalExperience=42 + skillCastCounts={linh_bao:1000000}: divergent one-fact mirrors both pass validation
totalExperience='999999' (string): Math.max coercion mints +99999 flat damage
totalExperience=10000: getCastLeveledSkillLevel -> Lv3 (writer needs 10000 real casts); same mirror feeds hidden-pathway offerGate evaluation
findings.bound_the_writer_upholds: totalExperience is a non-negative finite number, and skillCastCounts[id] === totalExperience whenever totalExperience > 0 (both written in one statement by the cast sink)
findings.suggested_fix_direction: validateSkillEntries: isNonNegativeFiniteNumber(totalExperience) + coherence check skills[].totalExperience === player.skillCastCounts[id] (mirror divergence or missing mirror -> issue); mirror-only entries for unlearned skills stay legal (respec leaves stale counts)

findings.summary: Nonneg-only counters with no producibility ceiling and no mirror to coherence-check against. Consumers re-authorize at their seams (tribulation settle re-checks transition+grade, quest claim re-checks bag + isBetaQuestEnabled + reconcile deactivates realm-ineligible entries, node purchase re-checks prereqs), so no mint path was found - but the magnitude ceiling question is open by construction for counters.
